$comment: Single source for where the sample organization is made, what its files are called and what its groups, projects and custom roles are called (architecture §11, 'Sample organization'). xtask (xtask/src/dataset.rs), the program bb-sample (crates/bb-sample/src/layout.rs) and the end-to-end tests (web/app/e2e/support/sample.ts) read it; nothing else names a folder, a file, the variable, a group, a project or a custom role. The folders are relative to the work folder and use / as separator.

organization.$comment: The code names a group, a project or a role by its key (groups and roles) or its short name (projects); this is what people read. The first four projects have their project lead, in the order of the people of the plan.

issues.$comment: What the sample organization holds besides the people (architecture §11, 'Projects'): how many issues, in which projects and of which types, the own fields, labels and tags, and how many relations and comments. 'total' is the full sample (the demo and the browser tests); 'smallTotal' is the smaller one that cargo xtask dataset sample --check makes four times and cargo xtask dev --sample makes for development. 'area' names the list of things in crates/bb-sample/data/issues.toml that the titles of a project are made from. Every other count is scaled from 'total' to the number asked for, and the check holds the made counts against these within 'tolerancePercent'. The names of types are the starting issue types; the fields are made through the same use case as the screen for own fields.

work.$comment: How the people work together (architecture §11, 'Working together'): the project that has a workflow of its own, the files on issues and comments, and what Contributors, Guests and Viewers do. Counts are those of the full sample and are scaled to the issues asked for like the others.

large.$comment: The large dataset of PERF-01 (architecture §11, 'Large dataset', cargo xtask dataset large): the sample's kinds of things at the scale the budgets are measured on. 'people' and 'projects' count the sample's too. A share is in percent of the issues, the projects or the events; 'notifiedPercent' is how many of the newest events the notification reader makes notifications for.
